protocol: Recompute both modes on the same GPU, verified original RGB pixels, every fifth frame of each registered clip. Identical official Nano checkpoint and thresholds; only tile dimensions differ. Freeze all predictions before reading ball reference labels. No threshold or model search.
acceptance: On each development game and fixed recheck game, one-to-one IoU>=0.5 matches must increase >=20 percent relative to baseline; unmatched predictions must not increase more than 25 percent. Positive reference and baseline match counts required. Pass permits longer external validation only, never automatic final promotion.
limits: Sparse previously exposed short training clips; no temporal tracking validation, in-play ball identity, possession or exhaustive negative labels. Timing is descriptive local runtime, not a hardware benchmark.
